scope: Optional source-visible preservation scan for an explicit photoreal job

request.snapshot: The value is copied into the durable photoreal job and retry settings. Later UI changes do not rewrite the job.
request.styleIndependence: Built-in and user-saved photoreal Styles do not change this switch.

capability.advertisedOnlyWhen: The companion has the exact bounded scanner, validator, compiler and fallback implementation available.
capability.passiveRead: Health and Jobs reads do not load the scanner, open source media, acquire the GPU lease, or wake a worker.

execution.trigger: The explicit worker execution of a photoreal job whose snapshotted switch is true.
execution.source: The same validated source image used by the photoreal adapter. The scan never rewrites or substitutes it.
ordering: validate the exact source and job snapshot
run the existing photoreal graph with the original reference image

scanDocument.coordinates: Finite normalized [0,1] x, y, width and height values only.
scanDocument.confidence: Finite [0,1] values only; low-confidence observations compile to no instruction.
faceObservations: leftEye state: open, closed, occluded, or unknown
rightEye state: open, closed, occluded, or unknown
gaze direction: left, right, up, down, forward, away, or unknown
mouth state: closed, parted, open, smiling, or unknown
left and right eyebrow visible geometry
bodyObservations: visible hand count and normalized positions
visible foot count and normalized positions
bounded clothing color, construction and accessory tokens
pose, crop, camera and background-layout tokens

compiler.behavior: Append only positive preservation statements supported by validated source-visible observations.
mustNotAdd: Japanese or another nationality or ethnicity
new styling, makeup, smile, expression, anatomy, clothing or background
compiler.referenceAuthority: The original source image remains the native image-reference authority; compiled text is supplemental.

conditions: scanner timeout or scanner-internal failure before photoreal inference
scanner memory release failure before safe inference admission
fallback.result: Discard the scan result and continue with the exact snapshotted user prompt plus the unchanged original reference image.
mustNotDo: reuse a partial or malformed scan
change Style or saved prompt state
turn an explicit user Job cancellation into a successful fallback

production.activationRequires: focused synthetic verification, real single-GPU canary, visual review and a later owner production decision
